meaning.en: A spirit so grand it pierces the sky.
meaning.zh: 精神或气概可以直冲彩虹，形容气势极其雄壮。

examples.zh: 英雄们的事迹气贯长虹。
examples.en: The heroes' deeds are of towering grandeur.

examples.zh: 他的诗气贯长虹，催人奋进。
examples.en: His poems soar in spirit and inspire the reader.

usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语，褒义书面语。

meaning.en: To use other people as a mirror for judging one's own conduct.
meaning.zh: 把别人当作镜子，对照自己的得失。

examples.zh: 以人为镜，才能看清自己的不足。
examples.en: Using others as a mirror lets you see your own shortcomings.

examples.zh: 领导要以人为镜，及时纠正错误。
examples.en: Leaders should learn from others and correct mistakes promptly.

story.en: Taizong said of Wei Zheng: 'With bronze as a mirror one can straighten one's cap; with history as a mirror one can see rise and fall; with people as a mirror one can see gain and loss' (以人为镜，可以明得失).
story.zh: 唐太宗：“夫以铜为镜，可以正衣冠；以古为镜，可以知兴替；以人为镜，可以明得失。”

usage.en: Often with 以铜为镜、以古为镜.
usage.zh: 常与“以铜为镜”“以古为镜”并说。

meaning.en: To shift one's own trouble or guilt onto someone else.
meaning.zh: 把自己的灾祸或罪责转移给别人。

examples.zh: 他想嫁祸于人，却被监控拆穿了。
examples.en: He tried to pin it on someone else, but the CCTV exposed him.

examples.zh: 出了问题就嫁祸于人，这样的人不能共事。
examples.en: Someone who blames others for every problem isn't fit to work with.

meaning.en: To make a show of wanting to die over some setback.
meaning.zh: 形容以自杀相威胁，哭闹不休。

equivalents: make a scene about wanting to die

examples.zh: 为了这点小事，她就寻死觅活。
examples.en: She makes a drama of wanting to die over such a trifle.

examples.zh: 别动不动就寻死觅活的，好好谈。
examples.en: Don't threaten the worst at every turn; talk it through properly.

usage.en: Predicate; casual and critical. Serious talk of suicide should be taken seriously.
usage.zh: 多作谓语，口语，带批评意味。

meaning.en: Time stretching on until the earth grows old; for ever.
meaning.zh: 经历极长的时间，形容时间久远。

examples.zh: 我们的爱，就算地老天荒也不会变。
examples.en: Our love won't change even till the end of time.

examples.zh: 等到地老天荒，我也愿意。
examples.en: I'd wait till the end of time.

meaning.en: Sewing or embroidering quickly and deftly.
meaning.zh: 形容缝纫、刺绣动作快而熟练。

examples.zh: 奶奶飞针走线，不一会儿就缝好了。
examples.en: Grandma's needle flew and the seam was sewn in no time.

examples.zh: 绣娘飞针走线，一幅花鸟渐渐成形。
examples.en: The embroiderer's needle flew, and a picture of birds and flowers took shape.

meaning.en: Fond of showing off strength and picking fights.
meaning.zh: 喜欢逞强，爱打架斗殴。

examples.zh: 他年少时好勇斗狠，没少惹事。
examples.en: In his youth he was always spoiling for a fight and caused no end of trouble.

examples.zh: 好勇斗狠的作风要不得。
examples.en: A pugnacious attitude won't do.

usage.en: Predicate or attributive. 好 is read hào.
usage.zh: 多作谓语、定语。“好”读 hào。

meaning.en: A dream of wealth and glory that comes to nothing.
meaning.zh: 比喻想要实现的美梦终成泡影。

equivalents: fleeting glory that fades like a dream

examples.zh: 多年的努力最后成了黄粱一梦。
examples.en: Years of effort turned out to be only a pipe dream.

examples.zh: 富贵荣华，不过黄粱一梦。
examples.en: Wealth and glory are no more than a passing dream.

story.en: A scholar dozing on a pillow dreams a whole lifetime of success, and wakes to find the millet not yet cooked.
story.zh: 沈既济《枕中记》：卢生在邯郸客店枕上做了一生富贵的梦，醒来店主的黄粱饭还没有熟。

meaning.en: The nation is conquered and families are destroyed.
meaning.zh: 国家被攻破，家庭也随之毁灭。

equivalents: the nation falls and homes are lost

examples.zh: 国破家亡的惨痛，他终生难忘。
examples.en: He never forgot the agony of a ruined country and a lost home.

examples.zh: 面对国破家亡，爱国志士奋起抗争。
examples.en: Facing national ruin, patriots rose to resist.

natural: many a little makes a mickle

meaning.en: Little by little, soil piled up becomes a mountain.
meaning.zh: 一点一点地积累土，最终成为高山，比喻积少成多。

equivalents: many a mickle makes a muckle

examples.zh: 学习要积土成山，不能急于求成。
examples.en: Study builds up bit by bit, so don't rush for quick results.

examples.zh: 积土成山，每天存一点，也是一笔钱。
examples.en: Little by little it adds up; a bit saved each day becomes a sum.

story.en: Xunzi: 'Piled earth becomes a mountain and wind and rain arise there; piled water becomes a deep pool and dragons are born there.'
story.zh: 《荀子·劝学》：“积土成山，风雨兴焉；积水成渊，蛟龙生焉。”

literal: Mount Tai · press down · crown of head

meaning.en: An overwhelming force bearing down.
meaning.zh: 像泰山压在头上，比喻来势凶猛，压力极大。

examples.zh: 敌军如泰山压顶般压过来。
examples.en: The enemy army bore down like an avalanche.

examples.zh: 考试前，他感到压力如泰山压顶。
examples.en: Before the exam he felt crushing pressure.

usage.en: Often 如泰山压顶/泰山压顶之势.
usage.zh: 常说“如泰山压顶”“泰山压顶之势”。

meaning.en: Terrified in every way.
meaning.zh: 形容惊慌恐惧到极点。

examples.zh: 地震来临时，人们惊恐万状。
examples.en: When the earthquake hit, people were terrified.

examples.zh: 孩子惊恐万状地躲在了床底下。
examples.en: The child hid under the bed, utterly terrified.

meaning.en: Good and bad perish together in a disaster.
meaning.zh: 美玉和石头一起被烧毁，比喻好坏不分，同归于尽。

examples.zh: 两家公司拼价格，最后玉石俱焚。
examples.en: The two firms fought a price war and both went under.

examples.zh: 他宁愿玉石俱焚，也不肯让步。
examples.en: He would rather destroy everything than yield.

story.en: 'When fire sweeps the Kun ridge, jade and stone burn alike' (火炎昆冈，玉石俱焚).
story.zh: 《尚书·胤征》：“火炎昆冈，玉石俱焚。”

date.zh: 东晋 · 约4世纪初（伪古文《尚书》篇章）
date.en: Eastern Jin, early 4th c. (spurious “Old Text” chapter of the Book of Documents)

meaning.en: Having both courage and good judgement.
meaning.zh: 既有胆量又有见识。

examples.zh: 这位年轻的将领有胆有识。
examples.en: The young general has both courage and insight.

examples.zh: 他是一个有胆有识的企业家。
examples.en: He's a bold, farsighted entrepreneur.

natural: spell out the pros and cons

meaning.en: To explain the advantages and disadvantages to persuade someone.
meaning.zh: 向人讲明事情的利害关系，劝他改变主意。

examples.zh: 我们向他晓以利害，他终于放弃了。
examples.en: We spelled out the stakes and he finally gave up.

examples.zh: 民警耐心地对当事人晓以利害。
examples.en: The police patiently explained the consequences to those involved.

usage.en: Often 动之以情，晓之以理，晓以利害. 晓 is read xiǎo.

meaning.en: A house full of visiting guests.
meaning.zh: 来访的客人很多，挤满门庭。

examples.zh: 新店开张，宾客盈门。
examples.en: At the opening of the new shop, guests thronged the door.

examples.zh: 喜宴上宾客盈门，热闹非凡。
examples.en: The wedding banquet was packed with guests and very lively.

usage.zh: 多作谓语，书面语，喜庆场合。

meaning.en: To back one's own faction and attack outsiders.
meaning.zh: 偏袒同伙，攻击意见不同的人。

examples.zh: 朝中党同伐异，贤才难以施展。
examples.en: Factionalism at court kept able men from doing their work.

examples.zh: 公司里党同伐异的风气必须杜绝。
examples.en: The culture of cliquishness in the company must end.

story.en: The preface to the 'Biographies of the Proscribed Factions' in the Book of the Later Han describes officials who 'backed their own faction and attacked those who differed' (党同伐异), turning court politics into feuding.
story.zh: 《后汉书·党锢列传序》论及当时士人“至有党同伐异之论”，形容结党营私、排斥异己。

meaning.en: Everyday needs: food, clothing and other expenses.
meaning.zh: 吃的、穿的、用的和各项日常开销。

examples.zh: 家里的吃穿用度都由她安排。
examples.en: She arranges all the household's food, clothing and daily needs.

examples.zh: 孩子的吃穿用度，父母从不吝啬。
examples.en: The parents never skimp on their child's food and clothing.

usage.en: Noun phrase. 度 here is read dù.

meaning.en: To advance in separate columns and then strike together.
meaning.zh: 军队分路前进，再会合起来攻击敌人。

equivalents: advance in columns and strike as one

examples.zh: 三路大军分进合击，包围了敌军。
examples.en: Three armies converged from separate directions and surrounded the enemy.

examples.zh: 警方分进合击，一举抓获了嫌犯。
examples.en: The police closed in from several directions and caught the suspects at one stroke.

usage.en: Military term, now also used of police or business operations.
usage.zh: 军事用语，也用于警务等。

meaning.en: Utterly tasteless or dull.
meaning.zh: 像嚼蜡一样没有味道，形容文章或讲话枯燥无味。

examples.zh: 这场报告味同嚼蜡，听得人直打瞌睡。
examples.en: The talk was dry as dust and made everyone doze off.

examples.zh: 心情不好，再好的菜也味同嚼蜡。
examples.en: When you're in a bad mood, even the best dish tastes like nothing.
